hotspots.title: Trump Administration's Policy Controversies and Legal Challenges
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration faces an aggressive wave of legal challenges, legislative pushback, and impeachment efforts across multiple policy domains. Key battles include federal court injunctions blocking immigration restrictions, state lawsuits over offshore wind deal cancellations, environmental deregulation backlash, and 26 articles of impeachment introduced in the House.
hotspots.affect: This topic commands top attention due to intense moral polarization, escalating legal warfare, and extreme political stakes surrounding executive authority.

hotspots.title: Trump vs. Mainstream Media Conflict
hotspots.blurb: Conflict between the White House and major press organizations spiked following decisions to ban mainstream outlets like CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from White House events and Air Force One travel. Conservative network Real America's Voice was offered travel access in place of barred outlets, driving intense debates over press freedom.
hotspots.affect: The conflict generates visceral affective investment, framed as necessary anti-bias retaliation by supporters and an authoritarian attack on journalism by critics.

hotspots.title: Trump's High-Stakes Xi Jinping Summit
hotspots.blurb: President Trump concluded a high-stakes state visit with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, establishing a two-month trade truce extension and bilateral AI safety communication channels. High-profile tours of the National Archives accompanied tense negotiations where no permanent economic breakthroughs were achieved.
hotspots.affect: The summit drives intense media focus through high-stakes geopolitical framing and economic uncertainty involving the world's two major superpowers.

hotspots.affect: This story garners sustained coverage as a visual spectacle of populist enthusiasm and cultural alignment for Trump's base.

hotspots.title: AI Risks and Trump's Tech Embrace
hotspots.blurb: Debates around artificial intelligence governance intensified following U.S.-China bilateral agreements on AI safety protocols and ongoing warnings from tech whistleblowers regarding rogue AI agent risks. Concurrently, Trump's attempt to rebrand artificial intelligence as 'super intelligence' drew mixed international reactions.
hotspots.affect: The narrative evokes significant affective investment by blending existential technological alarm with international regulatory power moves.
